presets.label: Mesh gradient
presets.hint: Four soft colours drifting into each other; the first one leans towards your pointer.

presets.label: Silk gradient
presets.hint: A tilted, slowly folding ribbon of colour in the style of modern product pages. Scrolling shifts the palette; the pointer nudges the folds.

presets.label: Noise flow
presets.hint: Contour lines streaming through warped noise, like wind on a weather map. The flow bends towards your pointer.

presets.label: Metaballs
presets.hint: Glossy blobs that melt into each other like a lava lamp; one of them follows your pointer.

presets.label: Grain & dither
presets.hint: A soft dusk gradient broken into retro dither steps with film grain on top; a pool of light follows your pointer.
